what: When the hand-drawn arrow beside the button comes in above the bottom 12% of the screen, it is drawn from bottom to top in .4s ease-out (clip-path), then starting 1.5s later, every 1.75s and only during the first 1/7, it slides 16px diagonally toward the button, squashes to .8x and bounces back — a gesture pointing and saying press here

options.look: ul-lr: Springs off to the lower right (arrow attached at upper left). Default is lower left (ur-ll)
options.look: from-bottom: Draws from top to bottom (default is bottom to top)
options.--fx-amp: Bounce distance multiplier (via style), default .8 (20px × .8) — small arrow .5
options.--fx-wait: Time from being drawn to the first bounce (via style), default 1.5s
options.[data-fx-part=bounce]: Bouncing cell (child) — bounce direction stays the same even if the arrow inside is rotated or flipped

from.where: index.html .sg-cta__arrow (hand-drawn arrow pointing at the ”Details” button) — original .arrow-reveal-bounce
